FROM FIRST ENQUIRY TO FOLLOW-UP

How it works.

01 / ORGANISE

Bring the enquiry in.

Keep customers, project details, files and quotes together. On Professional and Business, AI reads incoming emails and attachments and drafts a schedule for you to check.

02 / ESTIMATE

Price it up.

Use your own product library, material rates and mould allowances. Paste rows straight from Excel, fill in anything missing and send a branded quote.

03 / FOLLOW THROUGH

Follow it up.

Track revisions, record wins and losses and see which quotes need chasing. Everyone on the team sees the same picture, with permissions and review steps where you need them.
